# Content-addressed key computation

Cache keys are the hex SHA-256 of the concatenation: template_id + '\0' + template_version + '\0' + model_id + '\0' + input_hash.

Ensure keys uniquely and deterministically identify the exact combination of template, version, model, and input so cached entries are content-addressed and never stale.
